data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 8
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
¡Oye!  
[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Let's talk… Vamos a hablar  
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres  
Feel the rhythm and sing with me.  

[Verse]  
Market's alive, colors so bright  
Buenas… buenas, it's a beautiful sight.  
¿Qué tal?… How's it going today?  
People smiling, in every way.  

excuse me, pardon me… Disculpa  
I need to find the freshest tea.  
Cuídate… take care, my friend  
Hasta pronto… see you again.  

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Let's talk… Vamos a hablar  
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres  
Feel the rhythm and sing with me.  

[Verse]  
¡Oye! What's your name?… ¿Cómo te llamas?  
Mucho gusto… nice to meet ya.  
Where are you from?… ¿De dónde eres?  
¿Tienes años?… How old are you, my chum?  

The market's bustling, energy's high  
¿Qué haces?… What are you doing? Tell me why.  
Friendly faces, laughter in the air  
De nada… you're welcome, it's all good here.  

[Bridge]
